summary.en: Founded by the Mexica on an island in Lake Texcoco, Tenochtitlan became the capital of the Aztec empire. Cortés rebuilt it as the Spanish city of México, capital of New Spain, on the ruins, and the lake was gradually drained. It has been the capital of independent Mexico since 1821.
summary.zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰由墨西加人建于特斯科科湖中的一座岛上，后来成为阿兹特克帝国的都城。科尔特斯在废墟上把它重建为西班牙城市墨西哥城，作为新西班牙的首府，湖泊则逐渐被排干。自1821年起它一直是独立的墨西哥的首都。

polity.zh: 墨西加城邦（阿斯卡波察尔科的附庸）

sources.title: Michael E. Smith, The Aztecs (3rd ed., 2012)
Brian R. Hamnett, A Concise History of Mexico (3rd ed., 2019)
Britannica: Mexico City
UNESCO World Heritage: Historic Centre of Mexico City and Xochimilco

note: 1325 is the traditional founding date from Mexica annals; archaeology suggests settlement on the island began somewhat earlier.

summary.en: Francisco de Montejo the Younger founded Mérida in 1542 on the site of the Maya city of T'ho, reusing the stone of its pyramids for the cathedral and houses. It was the capital of Spanish Yucatán and, in 1841–1848, of the breakaway Republic of Yucatán.
summary.zh: 1542年，小弗朗西斯科·德蒙特霍在玛雅城市托奥的旧址上建立梅里达，用其金字塔的石料建造大教堂和民宅。它是西属尤卡坦的首府，1841至1848年间又是分离出去的尤卡坦共和国的首都。

polity.en: Viceroyalty of New Spain (Captaincy General of Yucatán)
polity.zh: 新西班牙总督辖区（尤卡坦都督辖区）

sources.title: Nancy M. Farriss, Maya Society under Colonial Rule (1984)
Britannica: Mérida
Wikipedia: Mérida, Yucatán

note: The start date of the Maya town of T'ho is approximate.

summary.en: The Aztecs planted a garrison called Huaxyacac ("among the gourd trees") in the Valley of Oaxaca in 1486, below the old Zapotec capital of Monte Albán. The Spanish town was named Antequera; it took the name Oaxaca after independence, and "de Juárez" in 1872 to honour Benito Juárez.
summary.zh: 1486年，阿兹特克人在瓦哈卡谷地设立名为瓦哈亚卡克（意为“葫芦树之间”）的驻军点，位于萨波特克古都阿尔班山之下。西班牙人建立的城镇名为安特克拉；独立后改称瓦哈卡，1872年为纪念贝尼托·华雷斯又加上“德华雷斯”。

polity.zh: 阿兹特克三方同盟（驻军）

sources.title: Britannica: Oaxaca
UNESCO World Heritage: Historic Centre of Oaxaca and Archaeological Site of Monte Albán
Brian R. Hamnett, A Concise History of Mexico (3rd ed., 2019)

summary.en: Le Cap, the richest port of French Saint-Domingue, was burned in 1793 during the revolution. After independence it was renamed Cap-Haïtien, then Cap-Henri when Henri Christophe made it the capital of his northern kingdom, whose citadel and palace stand on the hills behind.
summary.zh: 法兰西角是法属圣多明各最富庶的港口，1793年在革命中被焚毁。独立后改名海地角；亨利·克里斯托夫把它定为北方王国的都城时又改名亨利角，王国的城堡和宫殿就矗立在城后的山上。

sources.title: Laurent Dubois, Avengers of the New World: The Story of the Haitian Revolution (2004)
Britannica: Cap-Haïtien
Wikipedia: Cap-Haïtien

summary.en: The third Spanish capital of Guatemala, founded in the Panchoy valley in 1543 after a mudflow destroyed its predecessor, grew into a city of churches and convents. After the Santa Marta earthquakes of 1773 the capital moved to the present Guatemala City, and the old city became "La Antigua", the old one.
summary.zh: 这是危地马拉的第三座西班牙首府，1543年在前一座首府毁于泥石流后建于潘乔伊谷地，后来发展成为教堂和修道院林立的城市。1773年圣玛尔塔地震后，首府迁往今危地马拉城，旧城便被称为“安提瓜”，意为“旧城”。

name.en: Santiago de los Caballeros de Guatemala
name.zh: 危地马拉圣地亚哥-德洛斯卡瓦列罗斯

polity.zh: 危地马拉（1823—1841年属中美洲联邦）

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage: Antigua Guatemala
Britannica: Antigua Guatemala
Wikipedia: Antigua Guatemala

summary.en: First founded on Cuba's south coast, Havana moved to its sheltered northern bay in 1519 and became the gathering point of the Spanish treasure fleets, guarded by great fortresses. It replaced Santiago as Cuba's capital, was held by Britain in 1762–1763, and has been the capital of independent Cuba since 1902.
summary.zh: 哈瓦那最初建于古巴南岸，1519年迁到北岸一处隐蔽的海湾，成为西班牙运宝船队的集结地，由巨大的要塞守护。它取代圣地亚哥成为古巴首府，1762至1763年被英国占领，自1902年起是独立古巴的首都。

name.en: San Cristóbal de La Habana (south coast)
name.zh: 圣克里斯托瓦尔-德拉哈瓦那（南岸）
圣克里斯托瓦尔-德拉哈瓦那
圣克里斯托瓦尔-德拉哈瓦那
圣克里斯托瓦尔-德拉哈瓦那

sources.title: Louis A. Pérez Jr., Cuba: Between Reform and Revolution (5th ed., 2015)
UNESCO World Heritage: Old Havana and its Fortification System
Britannica: Havana

note: The first settlement date (1514 or 1515) and the date of the move to the north coast (1519) are given differently in sources.

summary.en: The oldest continuously inhabited European city in the Americas, Santo Domingo was laid out by Bartholomew Columbus and rebuilt by Nicolás de Ovando, with the first cathedral, university and royal court of the New World. The dictator Trujillo renamed it after himself in 1936; the old name returned after his assassination.
summary.zh: 圣多明各是美洲持续有人居住的最古老的欧洲城市，由巴尔托洛梅奥·哥伦布规划，经尼古拉斯·德奥万多重建，拥有新大陆第一座大教堂、第一所大学和第一个王家检审法院。1936年独裁者特鲁希略以自己的名字为它命名；他遇刺后旧名得以恢复。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage: Colonial City of Santo Domingo
Britannica: Santo Domingo
Frank Moya Pons, The Dominican Republic: A National History (3rd ed., 2010)

note: The 1821 "Spanish Haiti" interlude (December 1821 to February 1822) is folded into the Spanish period.

summary.en: One of the greatest Classic Maya cities, known to its own scribes as Mutal, Tikal was abandoned in the 10th century and swallowed by forest. The modern name, often explained as Itza Maya for "at the waterhole", came into use after the 1848 expedition of Modesto Méndez.
summary.zh: 蒂卡尔是古典期最伟大的玛雅城市之一，当时的书吏称之为穆塔尔。它在10世纪被废弃，淹没于森林之中。现名常被解释为伊察玛雅语“水潭边”之意，在1848年莫德斯托·门德斯的考察之后开始通行。

polity.en: Itza lands of Petén, then Spanish Guatemala
polity.zh: 佩滕伊察人领地，后属西属危地马拉

sources.title: Simon Martin & Nikolai Grube, Chronicle of the Maya Kings and Queens (2nd ed., 2008)
UNESCO World Heritage: Tikal National Park
Britannica: Tikal

note: Start date of the city name is approximate (Late Preclassic).

summary.en: In the 7th century the Snake (Kaan) dynasty moved its seat from Dzibanché to this city, whose ancient names were Uxte'tuun, "Three Stones", and Chiik Nahb, and made it Tikal's great rival. The botanist Cyrus Lundell named the ruins Calakmul, "two adjacent mounds", in 1931.
summary.zh: 7世纪时，蛇（卡安）王朝把王座从齐班切迁到这座城市，使它成为蒂卡尔的强大对手。该城古名为乌什特图恩（意为“三石”）和奇克纳布。1931年植物学家赛勒斯·伦德尔把这片遗址命名为卡拉克穆尔，意为“两座相邻的土丘”。

name.zh: 乌什特图恩 / 奇克纳布

sources.title: Simon Martin & Nikolai Grube, Chronicle of the Maya Kings and Queens (2nd ed., 2008)
UNESCO World Heritage: Ancient Maya City and Protected Tropical Forests of Calakmul, Campeche
Wikipedia: Calakmul

note: The date of the Kaan move to Calakmul (c. 631–635) is debated.

summary.en: Lakamha', "Big Water", named for its many streams, was the seat of the Baakal kings, including Pakal the Great. Abandoned around 800, it took its modern name from the Spanish town of Santo Domingo de Palenque, founded nearby in 1567; palenque means "palisade".
summary.zh: 拉卡姆哈意为“大水”，因城中溪流众多而得名，是巴卡尔诸王（包括巴加尔大帝）的王都。约800年后被废弃，现名来自1567年在附近建立的西班牙城镇圣多明各-德帕伦克；“帕伦克”意为“栅栏”。

sources.title: Simon Martin & Nikolai Grube, Chronicle of the Maya Kings and Queens (2nd ed., 2008)
UNESCO World Heritage: Pre-Hispanic City and National Park of Palenque
Britannica: Palenque

summary.en: The southernmost great Maya city, called Oxwitik in its inscriptions, was ruled by sixteen kings from Yax K'uk' Mo' in 426. Its modern name comes from the Spanish; the royal judge Diego García de Palacio described the ruins in 1576.
summary.zh: 科潘是最南端的大型玛雅城市，铭文中称为奥克斯维提克，自426年的亚什·库克·莫起由十六位国王统治。现名源自西班牙人；王家法官迭戈·加西亚·德帕拉西奥于1576年描述过这片遗址。

sources.title: Simon Martin & Nikolai Grube, Chronicle of the Maya Kings and Queens (2nd ed., 2008)
UNESCO World Heritage: Maya Site of Copan
Wikipedia: Copán

note: The reading of the emblem-glyph place name as Oxwitik is generally accepted but not certain.

summary.en: Founded by French colonists in 1749, Port-au-Prince became the capital of Saint-Domingue in 1770. The revolutionaries renamed it Port-Républicain in 1793; Dessalines restored the old name. It has been the capital of Haiti since independence and was devastated by the 2010 earthquake.
summary.zh: 太子港由法国殖民者于1749年建立，1770年成为圣多明各首府。1793年革命者将其改名为共和港，德萨林恢复了旧名。独立以来它一直是海地首都，2010年地震中遭受毁灭性破坏。

polity.zh: 圣多明各（法兰西共和国）

sources.title: Laurent Dubois, Avengers of the New World: The Story of the Haitian Revolution (2004)
Britannica: Port-au-Prince
Wikipedia: Port-au-Prince

summary.en: The English fortified the sandspit at the mouth of Kingston harbour after taking Jamaica in 1655 and renamed it Port Royal at the Restoration of Charles II. A haven for buccaneers like Henry Morgan, it was one of the richest towns in English America until two-thirds of it sank in the 1692 earthquake.
summary.zh: 英国人1655年夺取牙买加后，在金斯敦港口的沙嘴上修筑工事，查理二世复辟时将其改名为罗亚尔港。这里是亨利·摩根等海盗的避风港，曾是英属美洲最富庶的城镇之一，直到1692年地震中三分之二的城区沉入海中。

polity.zh: 英属牙买加（共和国时期）

sources.title: Michael Pawson & David Buisseret, Port Royal, Jamaica (1975)
Britannica: Port Royal
Wikipedia: Port Royal

modern.zh: 圣克里斯托瓦尔-德拉斯卡萨斯

summary.en: Founded by Diego de Mazariegos in 1528 in a highland valley of Chiapas, the town was the Spanish seat of the province and of the bishopric once held by Bartolomé de las Casas, whose name was added in 1848. Chiapas joined Mexico in 1824. In 1994 the Zapatistas occupied the town.
summary.zh: 该城由迭戈·德马萨列戈斯于1528年建于恰帕斯高原的一处谷地，是西班牙恰帕斯省和主教区的驻地，巴托洛梅·德拉斯卡萨斯曾任该教区主教，1848年城名中加上了他的名字。恰帕斯于1824年并入墨西哥。1994年萨帕塔民族解放军占领了这座城镇。

polity.zh: 西属恰帕斯（危地马拉都督辖区）

name.zh: 圣克里斯托瓦尔-德拉斯卡萨斯
圣克里斯托瓦尔-德拉斯卡萨斯

sources.title: Jan de Vos, Vienen de lejos los torrentes: una historia de Chiapas (2010)
Britannica: San Cristóbal de Las Casas
Wikipedia: San Cristóbal de las Casas

note: The town briefly carried other names in 1529–1531 (Villaviciosa, San Cristóbal de los Llanos), folded into the first entry.

summary.en: The Franciscan mission of Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe, founded in 1659 at the pass where the Camino Real crossed the Rio Grande, grew into El Paso del Norte. Benito Juárez's government held out here in 1865–1866, and the town was renamed in his honour in 1888; the settlement north of the river became El Paso, Texas.
summary.zh: 1659年，方济各会在卡米诺雷亚尔大道跨越格兰德河的隘口建立瓜达卢佩圣母传教站，后来发展为北方隘口镇。1865至1866年贝尼托·华雷斯的政府在此坚守，1888年该城改名以纪念他；河北岸的聚落则成为得克萨斯州的埃尔帕索。

sources.title: Britannica: Ciudad Juárez
Oscar J. Martínez, Border Boom Town: Ciudad Juárez since 1848 (1978)
Wikipedia: Ciudad Juárez

summary.en: Founded under Viceroy Mendoza in 1541 in the valley of Guayangareo, the city took the name Valladolid and became the seat of the bishopric of Michoacán, built in pink stone. It was the birthplace of Morelos and Iturbide and was renamed Morelia in 1828 in honour of Morelos.
summary.zh: 该城于1541年在门多萨总督治下建于瓜扬加雷奥谷地，后改名巴利亚多利德，成为米却肯主教区驻地，城中建筑多用粉红色石料。这里是莫雷洛斯和伊图尔比德的出生地，1828年为纪念莫雷洛斯改名莫雷利亚。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage: Historic Centre of Morelia
Britannica: Morelia
Wikipedia: Morelia

note: Sources differ on when the name Valladolid was adopted (1545 or 1578).

summary.en: Juan Ponce de León founded Caparra inland in 1508; in 1521 the settlers moved to the islet at the harbour mouth. At first the town was called Puerto Rico and the island San Juan Bautista, but the names swapped over time. Spain's fortress of El Morro guarded it until the United States took the island in 1898.
summary.zh: 胡安·庞塞·德莱昂于1508年在内陆建立卡帕拉；1521年定居者迁到港口入口处的小岛上。起初城镇称为波多黎各，全岛称为圣胡安包蒂斯塔，后来两个名称逐渐互换。西班牙的莫罗城堡守卫着这里，直到1898年美国夺取该岛。

name.en: Puerto Rico / San Juan Bautista de Puerto Rico
name.zh: 波多黎各 / 圣胡安包蒂斯塔-德波多黎各

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage: La Fortaleza and San Juan National Historic Site in Puerto Rico
Britannica: San Juan
Wikipedia: San Juan, Puerto Rico

note: The swap of the city and island names was gradual; 1898 is a convenient boundary.
